title: AquaTerra in April 2025: {count} drives, from saplings to sharbat
description: April 2025 at AquaTerra: {count} drives across {placesCount} places, including Grow Green plantations at South City International School and food drives.
lede: In April 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month ran two stories side by side: the summer food and sharbat drives carried on from March, and the Grow Green plantations at South City International School put in saplings. Children's workshops ran through the month too, with {topPlace} the most frequent place.

sections.heading: planting at south city
body: [Grow Green](/impact/grow-green) drives 24.0 and 25.0 were both at South City International School, on 21 and 22 April, and each drive lists 70 saplings planted. The school also hosted Smiles Shared, an Earth Day workshop on 21 April, where volunteers led hands-on sessions on sustainability, waste and action.

Planting over two days at one school gives a series a clear home. It also made South City International School one of the month's most frequent places, level with Salt Lake, and it is the kind of place AquaTerra keeps going back to.

sections.heading: sharbat and food through the heat
body: The [Sharbat Seva](/impact/sharbat-seva) drives moved into mid-April with a new set of places. Drives 28.0 to 32.0 ran from 15 to 25 April at Pritam Apartment, Northern Park, Balaji Apartment, Dakhinashwar and Kakurgachi. The Dakhinashwar drive on 16 April turned a hot day into a cool celebration, with the same 20 litres of Rooh Afza.

[Food For All](/impact/food-for-all) ran through the same weeks, from Drive 11.0 at Lake Town Footbridge on 13 April to Drive 17.0 in Kolkata on 17 April, with stops at Gariahat, Salt Lake, Northern Park, Balaji Apartment and Dakhineshwar. The Balaji Apartment drive on 15 April describes nutritious food served to make sure no one slept hungry.

sections.heading: workshops, dogs and clothes
body: Pather Sathi hosted several of the month's children's sessions: Echoes of Joy on 5 April, Hands at Work on 12 April, Little Moments on 19 April and Time Together on 26 April. Each was a fun session where volunteers and children spent time together.

Elsewhere, World Health Day at Amader Pradakhep on 5 April covered wellness, nutrition and hygiene, and Body Basics at Helping Hands on 12 April covered menstrual health and hygiene. ReTee at Mahadevi Birla Sishu Vihar on 24 April showed how old tees can be upcycled into something new. On 19 April, [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) ran dog drives at Salt Lake, Howrah and Bangur on the same day, and Wear and Share collected old clothes at Salt Lake on 17 April.

sections.heading: how to help in april
body: The April mix is useful to know if you want to help. Plantation and sharbat drives can each be run by a small team, while workshops at Pather Sathi need volunteers who like working with children. [Join AquaTerra](/join) and say what you can do, or read [how to run a plantation drive](/impact/how-to-run-a-plantation-drive) first.

learnings: Planting over two days at one school, as Grow Green did in April, gives a planting series a clear home.
A heat-season sharbat drive is small enough for a few volunteers, which makes it an easy first drive to run.
A food series that runs across a week is easier to repeat across neighbourhoods than one large day.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in April 2025?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places in April 2025, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Grow Green planted saplings at South City International School, Sharbat Seva ran cooling drives across the city, and Food For All continued its food drives in mid-April.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra plant saplings in April 2025?
faqs.a: AquaTerra's Grow Green plantation drives 24.0 and 25.0 were held at South City International School on 21 and 22 April 2025. Each drive lists 70 saplings planted.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra run sharbat drives in April 2025?
faqs.a: Yes. Sharbat Seva drives ran from 15 to 25 April 2025 at places including Pritam Apartment, Northern Park, Balaji Apartment, Dakhinashwar and Kakurgachi, handing out Rooh Afza sharbat to passersby.

faqs.q: What workshops did AquaTerra run for children in April 2025?
faqs.a: Children took part in art, fun and health workshops in April 2025, mostly at Pather Sathi. Body Basics at Helping Hands covered menstrual health and hygiene, and World Health Day at Amader Pradakhep covered wellness and nutrition.

faqs.q: Can I join an AquaTerra plantation drive?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are between 14 and 19. Join AquaTerra with Google sign-in, wait for approval, and sign up for a team. Once a drive is done, it is written up on the site.
